verdict.rationale: Dover's only analytics-related evidence is a single marketing line claiming "full visibility into candidates, costs, and conversion," which glancingly touches funnel conversion. Nothing documents a reporting or analytics feature. The Kanban pipeline view is a pipeline overview, not funnel metrics, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented stage-by-stage conversion reports, time-to-hire metrics, source-effectiveness reporting, offer-accept rates, per-role and per-team breakdowns, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I see the hiring funnel honestly — stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and offer-accept rates per role and team

citations.quote: Full visibility into candidates, costs, and conversion.
